credits.title: Half
credits.overview: A mixed Japanese and Caucasian woman reflects on identity, belonging and the responsibilities and biases that accompany her background.

credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: The Witchening
credits.overview: A babysitter dismisses a child's bedtime story about a vengeful witch, but soon learns it's all true...

credits.title: Wrench
credits.overview: A recovering kleptomaniac plots an impromptu Christmas dinner with her unconventional family to win back her ex-boyfriend, but an unexpected proposal reveals old habits die hard.

credits.title: June
credits.overview: On the hottest day of summer, best-frenemies Emily and Nora embark on their usual quest to find something to do, completely oblivious to the fact that they are widely hated by absolutely everyone in their small town.

credits.title: The Runner
credits.overview: A woman goes for a run alone in the woods and doesn't return.

credits.title: Pull Out
credits.overview: One day after purchasing their first real adult pull-out couch, homebody couple Levi and Dillon's relationship is tested when an unexpected (and pungent) visitor arrives to stay the night.

credits.title: Dead End
credits.overview: When Lily finds out she's being cheated on, her best friends come to the rescue to lift her spirits and get revenge on her soon-to-be ex.

credits.title: Midnight Sun
credits.overview: Katie, a 17-year-old, has been sheltered since childhood and confined to her house during the day by a rare disease that makes even the smallest amount of sunlight deadly. Fate intervenes when she meets Charlie and they embark on a summer romance.
